framework_version: 三层多因子投研框架 v1.4 + 评分可解释性手册 v1.1 + p1_upgrade v1.0

indicators.name: vix
indicators.label: VIX
indicators.data_source: Yahoo Finance/FRED: VIX=16.70 as May 22 close
indicators.rationale: VIX 16.7处于『平静』区间，从前期18+回落。非恐慌也不是过度自满。低VIX+市场近高位暗示不排除自满风险但未达到<12阈值

indicators.name: put_call
indicators.label: Put/Call
indicators.scoring_rule: 无实时数据→中性假设。Put/Call≈0.6-0.8估算
indicators.data_source: 未获取到实时数据，基于低VIX环境中性估算
indicators.rationale: Put/Call数据不可用，SPX近高位+VIX低→Call偏多，取中性3

indicators.name: aaii_survey
indicators.label: AAII Bull-Bear Spread
indicators.data_source: AAII Survey week May 21, 2026: Bullish 31.7%, Bearish 43.6%, Spread=-11.9%
indicators.rationale: AAII散户极度悲观(Bear 43.6% > Bull 31.7%)，Spread -11.9%在-20%~-10%悲区间。逆向信号：散户悲观反而是历史底部机会。上周还曾报Bullish 39.3%→这周下降到31.7%，情绪急转恶化

indicators.name: dxy
indicators.label: 美元指数
indicators.scoring_rule: 走弱（对新兴市场有利）→base 3 + score_adjustment +1 = 4
indicators.rationale: DXY 99.24处于走弱趋势，低于100关口对新兴市场/CN资产有利。小幅走弱=score 4

indicators.name: credit_spread
indicators.label: 信用利差
indicators.data_source: 无实时IG OAS数据，基于VIX 16.7低波动环境判断
indicators.rationale: VIX 16.7+SPX健康→信用利差中性偏稳。无信用冻结或显著扩大信号。取中性3

indicators.name: var_95_1d
indicators.label: VaR(95%,1d)
indicators.data_source: p1_upgrade_v1.0 from TickFlow 500日日线滚动60日窗口

indicators.name: var_trend
indicators.label: VaR趋势
indicators.scoring_rule: VaR 20d MA vs 40d MA变化→评分→等权平均
